summary: First iteration full-stack test of FrameFlow Studio landing. Backend pytest (5/5) passing for POST/GET /api/leads (valid + invalid email 422) and POST /api/contact (valid + invalid 422). Frontend browser automation validated: IT default hero, IT<->EN language toggle, nav anchor scrolling (features/how/pricing/faq), demo dialog open/close, FAQ accordion single-open toggle, final CTA email form successfully persists a new lead to MongoDB (verified via GET /api/leads before/after count 3->4 and email match), /signup and /login rendering auth-email-form, footer legal links (privacy/termini/cookie) navigating and rendering legal-title. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; FastAPI applies middleware regardless but conventionally add middleware before including routers.
EmailForm: invalid-email path relies primarily on HTML5 validation (type=email + required); the JS regex fallback + toast.error rarely fires in real browsers. This is acceptable UX but worth noting.

Landing gallery is intentionally duplicated (mobile/desktop) both using data-testid='gallery' — as noted in review request, but multiple identical testids can trip strict selectors. Consider suffixing (-mobile/-desktop).
FAQ.jsx uses button data-testid=faq-item-{i} without aria-expanded — add aria-expanded={isOpen} for a11y and easier automated state checks.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed leads via frontend flow (TEST_final_ui_frameflow_v3@example.com) and pytest (TEST_lead@example.com, TEST_contact@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All specified data-testids exist and work: lang-toggle, nav-link-{features,how,pricing,faq}, hero-cta-demo, demo-dialog, demo-dialog-close, faq-item-0..N, final-email-form(-input/-submit/-success), nav-cta, nav-login, auth-email-form, footer-link-{privacy,termini,cookie}, legal-title. Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Public URL: https://frameflow-ai-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Note: gallery has two elements with data-testid='gallery' (mobile + desktop) — use .first when needed.
